sentence: Designers, agencies and tool authors who wrote about AI-generated web pages in 2025 and 2026 name one consistent cluster of traits: a purple or indigo gradient running to blue or pink, an unchosen default typeface such as Inter, one large radius and one soft shadow on every card, a row of 3 equal feature cards with emoji or icon tiles, a centred hero with a pill badge in a fixed section order, and generic benefit copy with invented proof [E1, E3, E5, E13, E33, E116, E120].

evidence.quote: Purple gradients. Inter font. Three boxes with icons arranged in a grid.
a fingerprint: the Inter typeface, an indigo-to-purple gradient, three rounded cards in a row, and a hero section that could belong to any of ten thousand other products.
Unchosen gradient Purple or indigo fading to blue, often on the headline
A centered hero in Inter , with a small pill-shaped badge sitting directly above the headline.
invented testimonials, placeholder logos still sitting in the bar, or a precise stat with no source

sentence: Labelling or disclosing AI authorship lowers liking, trust and perceived effort [E70, E71, E72, E73], and consumers forgive misrepresentation in AI-made ads less because those ads look low-effort [E74].

evidence.quote: Study 1 found increased positive judgements for human- compared to AI-labelled art across all criteria.

While the raters could not differentiate the two types of texts in the blind test, they overwhelmingly favored content labeled as "Human Generated," over those labeled "AI Generated," by a preference score of over 30%.
Thirteen experiments consistently demonstrate that actors who disclose their AI usage are trusted less than those who do not.
The AI-generated label significantly reduced perceived effort, whereas the human-made label did not differ from the unlabeled condition
consumers are less forgiving of AI-created misrepresentative ads than human-created ones because AI ads are perceived as involving less effort

sentence: When authorship is hidden, readers often cannot tell AI output apart and sometimes prefer it [E71, E75], and blind raters judged AI-generated prototypes usable but unoriginal [E93].

sentence: Fabricated content and broken behaviour do harm with no attribution at all: errors and technical problems cost a site credibility [E69, E92], and readers who learn the cues of fake reviews trust them less and buy less [E83].

evidence.quote: People reported that a Web site loses credibility when it has errors, technical problems, or distracting advertisements.
errors and broken links hurt a site's credibility more than most people imagine.
